svg.title: The path of the money, from fee structure to receipt
svg.desc: The fee structure fixes which fee costs how much. When you create bills yourself, or an automatic billing rule runs, the student's dues are made. When a payment is taken, a receipt is made. Running again for the same period skips the earlier bills, so money is never counted twice.
